# The versions of the packages scripts/install_python_env.sh installs, taken
# from the environment of docs/getting_started.md on 2026-11-19. jax, jaxlib
# and the ROCm plugins are the wheels of .github/ci-wheels.sha256, vLLM is
# vllm_lkg.version and MaxText is scripts/setup_sources.sh's pin.
#
# The JAX and MaxText side follows jax-titan's .github/ci-constraints.txt. The
# serving side follows vLLM: numpy stays below 2.4, which vLLM's mistral-common
# needs on Python 3.12, and transformers below 5.23.
#
# To update: install as the script does, without -c, in a new Python 3.12
# environment, and replace the lines below with the output of
#   python -m pip freeze --local --exclude-editable | grep -v ' @ '
